EC1: 1. Subject has attempted suicide associated with the current episode of MDD.
EC2: 2. Subject has a medical history of bipolar disorder, [OR] schizophrenia, [OR] and/or schizoaffective disorder.
EC3: 3. Subject has had vagus nerve stimulation, [OR] electroconvulsive therapy, [OR] or has taken ketamine (including esketamine) within the current major depressive episode.
